entry_state: Replacement premium connects removed and new obligations without inventing cash. Service loss, finance measurement, current presentation and old OCI reclassification retain separate origins. Fixed and variable benefits require different allocations; changing holdings freezes the old schedule. The binary claim example now shows why identical marginal laws can leave treaty recovery unidentified, with its general-method continuation still unread.
exit_state: Claim dependence and fitted reserve uncertainty do not alone identify future payments. Bootstrap validity depends on the conditioning information, process law, backward law and correct reserve centering. Even a justified payment law leaves the insurer compensation measure to choose. The new finite example defines that additional amount and begins the atom-aware upper-tail calculation.
findings: The two-stage example separates fit and process variation, while an alternative law preserves moments and changes tail probability.
Sparse zero residuals do not establish deterministic payments; failed draws and unsupported signed-claim treatment remain unresolved.

The bootstrap discussion distinguishes diagonal-conditioned from full-history targets, derives a backward-law counterexample and correct reserve centering, and preserves source-version limits. No new confirmed manuscript defect.
